name: Awakening in the Wastes
description: Survive the Ashfall Wastes and learn to operate as a Spark Seeker.|This tutorial will teach you how to move around, scavenge, harvest resources, and engage in combat. The wastes are unforgiving. Learn quickly.|Follow the guidance markers.

text: Listen carefully. Your consciousness is fragmentary.
You're waking up... in the Ashfall Wastes. Focus.
I am The Archivist. What remains of the Elder Archive preserved in this Data-Pad.
Humanity's last hope rests with us now.
The Overmind detected your emergence. It sends Scavenger Bots to scour the wastes.
You must survive. You must learn.
The world you're awakening into is a hellscape of rust and ruin.
But there is hope. The Spark still flickers somewhere in The Citadel.
You can move by clicking, or using WASD keys, or arrow keys.
Pay attention to every survivor you meet. Knowledge is scarce now.
Head outside this shelter. A Guard awaits. They can teach you the ways of the wastes.
completedText: Go. The Guard will show you how to survive.

text: Another survivor. Good.
I'm tasked with training Spark Seekers. You've got potential or you wouldn't be conscious.
Out here, survival means scavenging. Resources. Modules. Tech components.
First lesson: gathering. See those rusted metal frames? Harvest scrap metal from them.
Take this tool. Open your inventory with I. Equip it. Then harvest two piles of scrap.
This isn't a game, Seeker. Every resource matters. The Overmind has rendered this world barren.
completedText: Now teach yourself scavenging. Harvest two more scrap metal.

text: Listen, the scrap you collected... it's raw material.
In the broken industrial plants nearby, you'll find data cores and circuit fragments.
Use this extraction tool. Break them down into usable components.
This is how you survive. Deconstruct. Reconstruct. Survive.
completedText: Practice your extraction skills. Gather more tech components.

hasItemText: But survival means more than just gathering materials.
Scout the irradiated pools to the east. Harvesting rad-shards requires caution.
Use this container to collect them safely.
Don't linger too long—the radiation levels out there are elevated.
completedText: Gather rad-shards from the contaminated zones.

text: Great, one more thing and we're done with the boring stuff.
It's as much of a chore for me as it is for you so don't worry.
Go click on that cooking pot and cook these shrimps for me.
completedText: Go on, cook the shrimps for me.

hasItemText: Awesome, you're done with the boring stuff.
Head down that suspicious ladder to the left and meet me in the cave.
Don't question it, just trust me.
completedText: Head down the ladder and meet me in the cave.

text: Alright, Seeker. Time to learn combat.
The Overmind sends automated sentries to patrol the wastes.
Start with these Scavenger Bots. They're weak, but they WILL kill you if you're careless.
Take this plasma cutter. Disable 5 of them.
Aim for the optical sensors. It's the quickest way down.
completedText: Disable the Scavenger Bots. This is not optional.

text: Not bad, Seeker. You have the basics down.
But melee alone won't cut it out here. The mutated creatures are too fast.
I'm giving you a plasma rifle. Ranged weapons are essential for survival.
There are Rad-Crabs near the eastern ridge—they're aggressive and radioactive.
Use the rifle to take down 2 of them from distance.
Remember: stay mobile, conserve your drive, and never let them flank you.
completedText: Eliminate the Rad-Crabs with the rifle.

text: You're ready, Spark Seeker. That training is all I can offer.
The Wastes beyond are harsh and unforgiving.
Find supplies, build your strength, and uncover the truth about Project Genesis.
The Overmind's reach grows every day. We're counting on you.
Now go. Step through the portal. Your real journey begins.
completedText: You're ready, Spark Seeker. That training is all I can offer.
The Wastes beyond are harsh and unforgiving. Now go. Your journey begins.
